prompt: A compound has molecular formula C4H8O. The IR shows a strong C=O near 1715 cm⁻¹ (no O–H). The MS shows M⁺ = 72, base peak at m/z 43 (M−29), and a notable peak at m/z 57 (M−15). Which compound fits?
explanation: Formula C4H8O + ketone C=O at 1715 narrows to a ketone (not aldehyde — no 2720 cm⁻¹ aldehyde C–H). MS: loss of 15 (CH3) gives acylium at m/z 57 [CH3CH2-C≡O+]; loss of 29 (ethyl) gives m/z 43 [CH3-C≡O+]. Both α-cleavage products are hallmarks of 2-butanone.
